blocks.text: Clooney is a surname. Notable people with the surname include:

items: Amal Clooney, Lebanese-British lawyer and wife of George
Francis Xavier Clooney, American academic and Roman Catholic priest
Nick Clooney, American TV host and journalist, father of George
Rosemary Clooney (1928–2002), American singer and actress, aunt of George

blocks.text: Clooney is a civil parish of County Clare, Ireland, located to the northeast of Ennis, south of Inchicronan. The area is marshy, with the Oysterman's Marsh Natural Heritage Area in the vicinity. Clooney-Quin GAA is a GAA club for the Catholic parish of Clooney and Quin.
